meta.title: Versor Robotics | Autonomous machines for the fields of tomorrow
meta.description: Versor Robotics builds farm robots: a collaborative mobile robot that follows you and goes where you guide it, and an autonomous sprayer. Rugged, precise and quietly relentless.
meta.ogDescription: Autonomous machines for the fields of tomorrow.

hero.lede: Autonomous machines for the fields of tomorrow. We build farm robots with the soul of an arcade cabinet: rugged, precise, and quietly relentless.

vision.title:
A print

head for

pesticide.
vision.lede: Three machines spray a farm, and none of them can spray a plant. A tractor is wider than the row and cannot get in once the crop is up. A drone's downwash scatters the droplet before it lands. A person can reach anything but cannot spray the same way twice, and labour is scarce.

leaf.title: Under the leaf
leaf.text: The pest lives under the leaf. Every conventional sprayer works from above, so the underside stays dry. From the side, the whole leaf is wetted.

printer.title: Like a printer
printer.text: A printer lays ink only where there is something to print. Our column of nozzles looks sideways at the plant and opens only where there is a leaf. Gaps get nothing.

platform.title: One platform
platform.text: A four-wheeled autonomous robot that works inside grown crop rows, with attachments for logistics, spraying, harvesting and crop monitoring.

video.title: See it in the field<dot>.</dot>
video.soonText: The cameras are in the field. Check back shortly.

products.title: Pick your player<dot>.</dot>
products.lede: Two machines, one fleet. Slot them into your season like cartridges into a cabinet.

carrier.tagline: A mobile robot that gets around on its own, follows you as you work, and goes wherever you guide it by hand.

points.3: A light touch guides it anywhere, no hard pushing

spray.tagline: A column of nozzles rides down the crop row and sprays each plant from the side, only where there is a leaf.

points.1: Sprays from the side, under the leaf
points.2: Looks at the plant as it goes
points.3: Fires only at leaves, so gaps get nothing

features.title: Power-ups, built in<dot>.</dot>
features.lede: Four capabilities that make a Versor robot feel less like a machine and more like a crew member.

follow.title: Autonomous Follow-Me
follow.text: The robot locks onto its operator and walks the field with them, carrying crates, tools or a full tank. Want it somewhere else? A light touch of the hand guides it there.
follow.diagram: Top-down map: a rover follows its operator around a field

spray.title: Autonomous Spraying
spray.text: Set the rows, press go. The boom drives the lines and sprays along the path with nobody at the controls.
spray.diagram: Top-down map: a spraying rover drives across crop rows and wets them

asr.title: ASR Module
asr.text: Talk to your robot. Onboard speech recognition turns plain spoken commands into actions, even with gloves on and the engine running.
asr.diagram: A spoken command, 'Spray rows three to six', and the robot's spoken reply

waypoint.title: Waypoint Navigation
waypoint.text: Drop pins on the map and the robot drives the route in order: stop by stop, row by row, and back home.
waypoint.diagram: A map with four numbered waypoints; the rover drives them in order

contact.noteText: Tell us about your crops, your acreage and your biggest bottleneck. A real person will reply.

join.title:
Grow with

the fleet.
join.lede: We are engineers, agronomists and ex-arcade kids building machines that smell like soil and hum like synthesizers. Come build the fleet with us.

game.title: Field run<dot>.</dot>
game.canvas: Field Run: a side-on game where the Versor rover changes lanes to dodge rocks, sprays weeds and collects seeds.
game.readyText: Change lanes to dodge rocks, stumps and hay bales, and spray the weeds out of your way. Scoop up seeds. Don’t crash.
game.rotate: Tip: turn your phone sideways for a bigger field.

simulator.metaDescription: Try the pesticide printer's spray rig in your browser: change the mast, nozzles, pump and speed, and see live whether every plant gets sprayed.
simulator.title: Spray simulator<dot>.</dot>
simulator.intro: Play with the pesticide printer's spray rig: move the mast, switch nozzles on and off, change the pump, speed and crop, and watch live whether every plant gets its dose.
simulator.englishNote: The simulator's own labels and numbers are in English.

economics.metaDescription: Work out what a Versor spraying robot earns: change working days, farm sizes, prices and costs, and compare selling robots with renting out spraying as a service.
economics.title: Unit economics<dot>.</dot>
economics.intro: Move the sliders to see what one spraying robot earns and costs: sold outright to large farms and FPOs, or run as a spraying service for small farmers.
economics.englishNote: The calculator's own labels and numbers are in English.
